rounds.text: Kati Patang Lifestyle Ltd is severely under-appreciated by the market, trading near the very bottom of its fifty-two-week range at just ten percent of its high [E4]. This depressed valuation ignores a massive operational inflection point, evidenced by compounded sales growth surging by one hundred twelve percent over the trailing twelve months [E16]. This explosive top-line acceleration is further validated by positive screen reasons showing sales up quarter-over-quarter alongside accelerating earnings growth [E56, E57]. Furthermore, the company's asset efficiency significantly outperforms the broader sector, delivering a return on assets of negative twenty-three point two seven percent compared to the sector benchmark of negative forty point seven two percent [E7]. On a relative value basis, the price-to-book ratio of two point five eight times sits far below the sector benchmark of seven point three five times [E6]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of negative five point zero seven percent over the past five years [E50] and the ten-year compounded sales growth stands at zero percent [E13].
